slipwaddle: A small navy penguin lying flat on its tummy with its head up, a flat white patch on its face under the eyes, an orange flipper, and a cyan ice wake trailing behind it.
sledwaddle: A bigger flat penguin with an orange curl on its head, the white patch under its head, an orange flipper and the cyan wake.
blizzwaddle: The biggest flat penguin: orange curl on its head, orange fins along its back, a ring of cyan puffs at its front, the white patch under its head and the cyan wake.
oinkle: A small pink piglet with a long low body and a round head set forward, a flat round snout disc, two triangle ears, dark eyes and a short stub of tail on its rump.
snortle: A bigger pink pig: the head sticks out in front of the long body, with a snout disc, triangle ears, a tuft of pink bubbles on top, round hands and the stub tail.
tuskoink: The biggest pig: head forward of the long body, a snout disc with two white tusks curling up beside it, four pink bubbles on top, triangle ears, pink spikes along its back and the stub tail.
cubbun: A small tan bear sitting up with its two forearms crossed over the middle of its tummy, round ears, big dark eyes and pink cheeks.
brambun: A bigger bear with a green leaf sprout on its head and its two forearms crossed over the middle of its tummy.
grizzbun: The biggest bear: russet leaves fanned behind its head, a green sprout on top and its forearms crossed over the middle of its tummy.
spudsy: A small round tan potato with one tiny green sprout on top, brown bumps, two stubby arms and four stubby feet.
tatertot: A bigger potato with a taller green leaf sprout, brown bumps, stubby arms and feet.
hashbrawn: The biggest potato: a tuft of green leaves on top, brown bumps, long arms and four feet.
cloudlamb: A pale blue-white cloud-shaped sheep floating just above the ground, with puffs of cloud on its top and back, small pale ears and a ring of puffs underneath, eyes closed.
cumulamb: A bigger floating cloud sheep with more puffs on its top and underneath, and two curled golden ram horns on the sides of its head.
fluffasus: The biggest cloud sheep: a pair of peach feather-lobe wings swept back along its sides, with puffs on its top and underneath.
glimbug: A dark purple bug made of a small head ball over a big round belly, floating, with a crown of pale yellow spikes, a wide yellow wing out to the side and a huge glowing pale-yellow lobe behind it.
glimmerbug: A bigger dark bug with the pale yellow crown of spikes and the huge glowing pale-yellow lobe.
beaconfly: The biggest dark bug: pale yellow crown spikes, stubby arms out to the sides and the huge glowing pale-yellow lobe.
lampfin: A round dark-blue fish floating just above the ground, with a short beaded cream stalk rising over its head to a big round cream lure, cream fins, yellow eyes, a small smile and pale cone teeth.
lanternfin: A bigger blue fish with a larger cream lure on its stalk, cream fins on its back and tail, yellow eyes and pale teeth.
nightfin: The biggest blue fish: a huge cream lure, cream back fins, a pale blue wing fin at its tail and yellow eyes.
dragofruit: A small round pink dragonfruit with green scale spikes all over, a spiky green tail, closed happy eyes and a smile.
drakeberry: A bigger pink dragonfruit with taller green spikes, a green cone on its cheek, pink nubs for wings and closed happy eyes.
dragonbloom: The biggest dragonfruit: a large pale green wing swept up behind it, green spikes around its body, a green cone on its cheek and a smiling face.
quackle: A small yellow rubber duck shaped like a low flat boat, head up front, with a wide flat orange bill, closed happy eyes, the back of the hull swept up into a single point, and three small bubbles rising above its head.
bubbleduck: A bigger yellow duck: a taller column of bubbles rising above its head, a crest of bubbles standing on its back and the swept-up tail point.
soapduke: The biggest duck: a ruff of mixed-size blue-white suds bubbles behind its head that sticks out past the head outline, a tall column of bubbles above it, a bubble crest on its back and the swept-up tail point. The bill is clear.
